words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}) opens the surah by putting the quake into a temporal condition rather than a bare report. With the perfect passive {{ar:زُلْزِلَتِ}} ({{tr:zulzilat}}) after it, the event is framed as future-certain: the wording says when the quake-condition arrives, not if it might arrive. The particle also leaves the syntax suspended, because this first ayah gives the protasis while the answer is structurally awaited; the supplied evidence allows the response to be heard around 99:4, 99:6, or as an elided completion, so the opening should not be flattened into a self-contained timestamp. Its payoff is a threshold effect: certainty begins immediately, but resolution is deferred beyond the first line.

words.prose: {{ar:زُلْزِلَتِ}} ({{tr:zulzilat}}) is the first content word after {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}), so the surah moves straight from the temporal frame into the quake-event. Its perfect passive form makes {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضُ}} ({{tr:al-arḍu}}) the affected grammatical subject while leaving the external agent unnamed; the grammar should not be expanded by adding an explanatory actor. The feminine singular ending and recitational flow into {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضُ}} ({{tr:al-arḍu}}) bind the verb to that earth-subject before the final cognate noun arrives. The reduplicated {{ar:ز ل ز ل}} ({{tr:z-l-z-l}}) root makes the motion iterative and bodily: not a mild disturbance, but repeated destabilizing convulsion; the alternating z and l texture makes that back-and-forth motion audible in the word's surface. V4 keeps the local branch to shaking or disturbance, while the broader accepted branches of time's shocks and easy-slipping water remain outside the local sense. The root is also rare and crisis-marked across 2:214, 22:1, and 33:11, so this passive verb carries both cosmic shaking and undergone upheaval. Against the security-and-settlement pressure noted in the field, the stable earth is recast as a destabilized domain. Its sound returns in {{ar:زِلْزَالَهَا}} ({{tr:zilzālahā}}), turning the verb's action into the measure that will close the ayah.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضُ}} ({{tr:al-arḍu}}) is not an ordinary object after the verb; it is nominative passive subject, the named patient around which the clause is built. Its feminine singular agreement with {{ar:زُلْزِلَتِ}} ({{tr:zulzilat}}) locks the quake to one definite earth, and its placement between verb and cognate noun makes it the hinge between event and measure. The article and singular form narrow the range from land, soil, or region to the known terrestrial whole. That matters because the normally stable ground, floor, and settling-place is the thing being destabilized, and the common earth term becomes marked by the rare {{ar:ز ل ز ل}} ({{tr:z-l-z-l}}) event. The same referent then returns compactly through the hā suffix in {{ar:زِلْزَالَهَا}} ({{tr:zilzālahā}}), so the earth moves from passive subject to possessor of the quake's defining noun. Within the surah, this begins a local thread: earth recurs at 99:2 and the shaken substrate becomes the reporting surface at 99:4, so a place of settling and storage turns toward disclosure. The usual sky-earth pairing is absent here, keeping the frame concentrated on the terrestrial field rather than a vertical cosmos.

words.prose: {{ar:زِلْزَالَهَا}} ({{tr:zilzālahā}}) closes the ayah by turning the finite shaking into its own measure. As a maṣdar in cognate accusative function, it does not add a second object or a new event; it intensifies the same action named by {{ar:زُلْزِلَتِ}} ({{tr:zulzilat}}). The hā suffix makes the shaking earth-specific: the final word is not a generic earthquake label but the earth's own shaking, with the idafa keeping earth as both bearer of the quake and affected target, though that possession should be read grammatically rather than as a claim about hidden destiny. The qirāʾa contrast with {{ar:زَلْزَالَهَا}} ({{tr:zalzālahā}}) keeps a process-event pressure visible, and its changed opening vowel slightly shifts the onset weight while the canonical surface remains the local form. Distributionally, the gerund class is small and load-bearing, with the root field touching 2:214, 22:1, and 33:11. Structurally and acoustically, the final noun reprises the opening quake-root, shifts from passive verb to possessed accusative noun, and lands as the last beat; its repeated z and l around the long ā leave the ayah folding back onto the sound and measure of shaking itself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated root in `زُلْزِلَت ... زِلْزَالَهَا` joins a passive verb to its possessed cognate noun, with `الأرض` as the affected subject.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ordinary lower support is acted upon, while the cognate construction makes the disturbance exhaustive and proper to this earth rather than a passing tremor.

activation_trace.role: Shaking disturbance supplies the literal motion, and its verb-noun repetition intensifies that motion into the event's defining action.
The lower ground opposite the sky supplies the affected world-support, giving the disturbance a total terrestrial field.

changed_reading.before: A tremor happens to the ground.
changed_reading.after: The whole lower support is made to undergo its own defining and fully realized convulsion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `الأرض` is the locus normally associated with staying down and holding position, yet it is paired with doubled shaking.
baseline_models.mechanism: The event reverses the ground's normal anchoring function: what bodies cling to and weigh toward becomes the mover, so stability itself changes sides.

activation_trace.role: Sticking to the ground and lingering supplies the normal downward anchoring function that the verse overturns.
Shaking disturbance supplies the reversal by making the usual anchor generate movement.

changed_reading.before: The earth is merely the surface on which instability occurs.
changed_reading.after: The event overturns the earth's role as anchor: the thing that normally holds everything down now moves everything else.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next movement is not random collapse but an earth-driven transfer from inside to outside. Shaking reverses containment and makes the burden-bearing ground discharge what it held.

activation_trace.role: Shaking disturbance supplies the forceful loss of settled containment.
Ground-clinging and heaviness supply the containment function that is being reversed.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the outward transfer and makes disclosure, not mere displacement, the result.
The lower ground remains the grammatical actor, functioning as the container that now empties itself.
The load that weighs down supplies the concealed contents whose pressure and release give the convulsion a direction.

structural_cues: 99:1 and 99:2 coordinate feminine earth-predicates: it is shaken and then it brings out; the repeated possessive `-ها` binds its shaking to its burdens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shaking followed by the earth bringing concealed weight outward; I infer that the shaking opens or drives the extraction, while a live alternative is that shaking and ejection are parallel consequences rather than cause and effect.

changed_reading.before: The quake is a self-contained episode of violent motion.
changed_reading.after: The quake is an extraction mechanism: the earth's own convulsion makes it surrender what its stability had kept inside.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passive shaking first withholds an agent; the later causal clause supplies sovereign direction and a mode of imparted instruction. The earth's movement can therefore be read as enacted obedience rather than autonomous geophysical behavior.

activation_trace.role: The passive shaking supplies the commanded action while leaving its initiator initially unspoken.
The earth supplies the addressed material subject that performs the directive through its whole lower field.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the authority governing the earth's action.
The hidden imparting of knowledge supplies a directive received by the earth and converted into motion.

structural_cues: The passive verb in 99:1 suppresses its agent, while `بأن ربك أوحى لها` in 99:5 gives an explicit causal explanation addressed to the same feminine earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereign lordship, hidden impartation, and a causal clause; I infer an instruction-to-action arrow from impartation to shaking, while the live alternative is that the instruction concerns only the earth's later reporting.

changed_reading.before: An impersonal force shakes the earth.
changed_reading.after: The earth's total convulsion is a governed response: matter executes an imparted directive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The shaken ground becomes an evidentiary medium. Outward disturbance is paired with making hidden matters newly manifest, knowing their interior, and inscription, so the convulsion reads as activation of a terrestrial record.

activation_trace.role: The lower ground supplies the material substrate whose accumulated interior can become evidence.
Shaking disturbance functions as the activation that turns a silent substrate into a reporting one.
Bringing something forth and making it manifest supplies the earth's transition from holding events to disclosing them.
Knowledge of a report and of an affair's interior supplies evidentiary depth rather than surface noise.
Writing and inscription supply the archival analogy by which the earth can bear a recoverable record.

structural_cues: The earth remains the feminine subject across `زلزلت`, `أخرجت`, and `تحدث`, and `أخبارها` makes the reports its own.
The sequence moves from bodily motion to outward contents to articulated information.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manifestation, interior knowledge, and inscription; I infer that prior acts leave a recoverable trace in the ground and that shaking activates its legibility, while the live alternative is newly granted speech with no preexisting storage mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The earth shakes as inert matter.
changed_reading.after: The convulsion wakes a material archive: the ground ceases to be silent background and becomes evidence-bearing witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The single shared ground is followed by people issuing away in separated groupings for their intentional acts to be displayed. The convulsion therefore marks a routing threshold that dissolves common placement and produces differentiated trajectories.

activation_trace.role: The one lower ground supplies the common field from which differentiated human movement begins.
The convulsion breaks the shared settled arrangement and functions as the threshold into sorting.
Departing from a common watering place supplies an ordered image of issuing away from one source.
Human appearance supplies the population that emerges into the sorting field.
Dispersion and separation supply the differentiated trajectories produced after common groundedness ends.
Causing to see and making manifest supply the destination of the separated movement.
Intentional acts supply the person-specific material by which the outgoing groups are differentiated.

structural_cues: The sequence turns from singular earth to plural people qualified by `أشتاتا`, followed by the purpose clause `ليروا أعمالهم`.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies departure, dispersion, display, and intentional acts; I infer that the quake initiates a sorting process from common ground to distinct outcomes, while the live alternative is a later procession related temporally but not mechanically to the shaking.

changed_reading.before: The quake indiscriminately unsettles everyone on one surface.
changed_reading.after: The quake is the threshold at which one common ground gives way to routed, person-specific disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The largest possible terrestrial disturbance terminates in the smallest stated weights being measured and shown. Totality is therefore paired with resolution: the event dismantles concealment without erasing distinctions between acts or outcomes.

activation_trace.role: The earth-scale shaking supplies the macroscopic pole of the scale reversal.
The whole lower ground supplies the comprehensive field across which no local trace remains exempt.
Intentional action supplies the accountable unit preserved through the global upheaval.
Weight and measure supply exact calibration rather than indiscriminate exposure.
Minute scattered particles supply the microscopic resolution at which the comprehensive event still discriminates.
Inclination toward beneficial good supplies one morally differentiated outcome retained at minute scale.
Evil and harm supply the opposing outcome, preventing total disclosure from flattening moral difference.
Making something visible supplies the final conversion of minute weight into inspectable result.

structural_cues: The surah moves from the earth-wide cognate intensification in 99:1 to two tightly parallel clauses in 99:7-8 that repeat action, particle-weight, and seeing while changing only moral valence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a global convulsion, exact particle-weight, opposed values, and visibility; I infer that the first event opens a precision audit rather than causing indiscriminate ruin, while the live alternative is a rhetorical scale contrast without an instrumental relation.

changed_reading.before: A total earthquake suggests undifferentiated destruction.
changed_reading.after: The total earthquake inaugurates exact disclosure: maximal upheaval and microscopic discrimination operate together.

changed_reading.before: The quake is modeled only as impact, fracture, and violent resistance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the quake also acts as unsealing: resistance collapses and what the earth held issues outward like a released flow.

strongest_changes: The shaking became an extraction mechanism that reverses the earth from stable container to active discloser.
The passive convulsion became a directed act and then the activation of an evidence-bearing ground archive.
The earth-wide event acquired microscopic resolution, joining total upheaval to exact visibility of differentiated acts.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse's compact doubling supported several non-collapsible mechanisms: reversal of support, forced exteriorization, instructed material agency, testimonial activation, social sorting, and a macro-to-micro audit. The most distinctive result was that maximal disturbance did not erase detail but made hidden detail measurable and visible.
remaining_uncertainties: The context establishes sequence more securely than it establishes whether shaking mechanically causes ejection, testimony, and sorting.
The archive model cannot decide whether the earth preserves prior inscriptions or receives newly created speech at the event.
The speech-tremor and hydraulic readings depend on non-dominant or branch-distant images and must remain explicitly analogical.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Earthquake as forced testimony mechanism.** Lexical evidence: `ز ل ز ل B001` shaking disturbance; `ء ر ض B001` lower ground opposite sky; activated by `خ ر ج B002` extraction from hiddenness in 99:2, `ح د ث B003/B006` speech-report and disclosure in 99:4, and `و ح ي B001/B004` hidden/divine conveying in 99:5. Structural cue: 99:1 begins a temporal chain: shaking → output → human question → earth report → divine conveying. Assigned role: shaking is the mechanical trigger that converts silent ground into a reporting surface. Abductive move: the packet supplies sequence, not causality; I infer that disturbance loosens what had been held below so that report can occur. Reading change: the ayah is no longer only cosmic catastrophe; it is the first operation in an evidentiary procedure.

2. **The ground trembles like the human who will tremble.** Lexical evidence: `ء ر ض B008` trembling/shivering in a person; `ز ل ز ل B001` shaking; activated by `ء ن س B001/B002` visible human presence/perception in 99:3 and `ن و س B001` swaying instability in 99:6. Structural cue: the earth’s agitation precedes human bewildered speech and people’s issuing in unstable groups. Assigned role: the earth’s shaking becomes a bodily analogue for human destabilization. Abductive move: I supply a cross-domain mapping from ground-shake to person-shiver because the same packet makes earth and human both actors. Reading change: “the earth is shaken” also reads as the world assuming the body-language of humans who will face its evidence.

3. **Shocks of time compressed into one event.** Lexical evidence: `ز ل ز ل B002` time’s shocks/hardships; activated by `ح د ث B005` event/calamity of time and the repeated `يَوْمَئِذٍ` in 99:4 and 99:6. Structural cue: the initial `إذا` opens a condition whose consequences are named as “on that day” twice. Assigned role: the quake is an event that gathers ordinary shocks of time into a decisive temporal crisis. Abductive move: I infer that the day-language lets the idiom of time’s shocks function without replacing the physical quake. Reading change: the ayah reads simultaneously as material shaking and as the arrival of accumulated temporal hardship.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 99:6’s `ن و س B001` made the quake less one-directional: the earth is shaken first, but humans later appear as a swaying mass. 99:8’s `ش ر ر B004/B006` also retroactively made the shaking an act of loosening burdens and dangling attachments, not merely seismic violence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The ground is rendered as a trembling body.** Fixed `ز ل ز ل/B001` supplies shaking disturbance, while fixed `ء ر ض/B008` unexpectedly supplies trembling or shivering in a person. Structurally, the repeated root in `زُلْزِلَتِ ... زِلْزَالَهَا` encloses `ٱلْأَرْضُ` and gives the disturbance as its own suffixed quake. The earth branch's role is somatic: it makes the subject experience the motion as a body would. The projection of a human tremor onto the earth is the abductive move. The ayah then reads as the earth bodily trembling its particular tremor, not merely as terrain receiving external motion.

2. **The passive shock is a threshold into active testimony.** Fixed `ز ل ز ل/B001` supplies the initial disturbance and fixed `ء ر ض/B001` the lower substrate. The fixed ayah presents the earth as the patient of a passive verb; 99:2 and 99:4 then give it active feminine verbs, `أَخْرَجَتِ` and `تُحَدِّثُ`, and 99:5 supplies the commission `أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا`. The quake's assigned role is to open the transition from affected matter to acting witness. The packet does not state that shaking enables speech, so that directional arrow is inferred. On this reading the quake is a commissioning threshold, not an isolated catastrophe.

3. **A physical oscillation propagates into a temporal and social shock.** Fixed `ز ل ز ل/B002` supplies "time's shocks," and the later repetitions of `يَوْمَئِذٍ` in 99:4 and 99:6 provide an explicit temporal frame. At 99:6, `ن و س/B001` contributes swaying or wavering to `ٱلنَّاسُ`, and `ش ت ت/B001` contributes collective scattering. These branches assign the fixed quake a propagating role: lower ground oscillates, the human collective becomes unstable, and the group separates. The causal propagation from substrate to crowd is inferred, while the roots and sequence are packet-supplied. The quake consequently reads as a shock of time reorganizing society as well as a movement of earth.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 99:4-5 retrospectively changed the passive quake into the first stage of an authorized testimony: the earth later reports because it was addressed. The farther surprise at 99:6 was that `ن و س/B001` and `ش ت ت/B001` carry oscillation into the human collective. That later social motion corrects a catastrophe-only reading of the fixed quake and activates `ز ل ز ل/B002` as a shock belonging to a decisive time.
